description: This Java class `SalesManagerJpaDaoSupport` provides a generic data access object (DAO) implementation using JPA. It includes methods for CRUD operations, query building, filtering, sorting, and counting entities, with support for criteria queries and transaction management through Spring annotations.

classes.name: SalesManagerJpaDaoSupport
classes.description: A generic DAO support class that abstracts common JPA operations with criteria query support, transaction management, and flexible filtering, sorting, and counting of entities.

methods.name: buildTypedQuery
methods.description: Creates a typed query from criteria with optional limit and offset.

methods.name: filterCriteriaQuery
methods.description: Applies a filter expression to a criteria query.

methods.name: rootCriteriaQuery
methods.description: Creates a root for a criteria query based on the entity class.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by class and ID.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Retrieves a single entity matching a specific field value.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merges the state of a detached entity into persistence context.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes an entity from persistence context.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the state of an entity from the database.

methods.name: listEntity
methods.description: Lists entities with optional filtering, limits, offsets, and sorting.

methods.name: listEntityByField
methods.description: Lists entities filtered by a specific field.

methods.name: countEntity
methods.description: Returns the count of entities of a given class.

methods.name: countEntityByField
methods.description: Returns the count of entities filtered by a specific field.

methods.name: getSingleResultOrNull
methods.description: Safely retrieves a single result from a criteria or typed query, returning null if none found.
